info.title: Meshway control API
info.description: Durable control-plane identity, public-key associations and configuration intent. Receipts mean saved only; not runtime peer proof, connectivity or tunnel health.

200.description: Saved ordered endpoint authorization source and current diagnostics
Global-CAS ordered endpoint authorization save; missing keys defer only affected runtime paths

422.description: Invalid selectors or references, JSONC mismatch, or expanded publication capacity exhausted

200.description: Immutable node-scoped control-plane public-key association; not runtime peer proof

400.description: Invalid JSON, key or capability advertisement

409.description: Node or public key already differently bound, including revoked tombstones

200.description: Node-scoped connection intent with only local profile references and approved adjacent peers
Independently validated and durably saved connection receipt; not applied or connected

409.description: Revision or digest is not this node's current connections snapshot

200.description: Leased node-authenticated UDP self-observation; never authorization or peer identity proof

409.description: Superseded epoch, sequence, generation or socket observation

422.description: Invalid configuration scope or discovery claim

200.description: Read node-scoped acquisition CAS epoch; zero means no lease; no renewal or mutation
Record scoped runtime self-report; duplicate sequence preserves server receive time; never ACK or independent peer proof

409.description: Superseded or absent runtime lease, old sequence or changed same-sequence report

422.description: Configuration revision/digest mismatch, missing identity or invalid observation scope/state

200.description: Acquire runtime epoch by CAS; current instance retries preserve observation freshness

409.description: Expected epoch no longer current for a different instance; lease/report unchanged

422.description: Invalid instance ID, missing bound identity or epoch exhausted

200.description: Atomic node-scoped configuration, adjacency, directional access and public identities. Invalid access projects empty grants. No runtime or ACK assertion.

422.description: Fails closed above 64 union identities or 2 MiB snapshot

200.description: Credential-scoped authoritative node DNS bundle; DNS names do not grant access
Credential-scoped configuration and active public peers
Validated and durably saved receipt; not networking applied

409.description: Revision or digest is not this node's current snapshot

200.description: Enrolled node, or same active identity on a bound retry

401.description: Invalid, expired or differently consumed enrollment token

422.description: Address, inventory, or configuration capacity exhausted; token remains unused

200.description: Credential-scoped process contact; not tunnel health
Source connection plan, validity and inventory with independent saved-only receipts
Canonical global-CAS connection intent save; no runtime activation or transit/exit grant

422.description: Invalid connection plan or capacity exhausted

200.description: Current leased UDP self-observations; missing reports explicitly await reporting
Leased node self-reports with server receive TTL and current configuration matching; not authorization
One-use token, plaintext revealed only here
Combined saved endpoint authorization and routing preview
Single-network saved identity, immutable pools and authoritative node DNS intent
Saved network intent; not an Agent DNS application receipt

400.description: Invalid JSON or unknown fields; address pools cannot be edited

422.description: Invalid name, zone, TTL or publication capacity

200.description: Stored nodes sorted by ID
Normalized administrator-managed country metadata

400.description: Country must be two ASCII letters or null

200.description: Revoked node; repeated revocation preserves its timestamp
Global-CAS active-node tag assignment
Controller identity and total stored nodes including revoked nodes
Saved source policy and current diagnostics
Pure preview; no persistence
Canonical conditional policy save
Admin-owned tag catalog and active assignments
Global-CAS tag catalog save

AgentNodeResponse.description: Also lets a pending local enrollment recover its server-assigned node ID.

expected_epoch.description: Pin the initial epoch read across retries; never refresh after a conflict.

probe_fresh.description: A recent authenticated control-nonce probe, not merely a control heartbeat.

reason.description: Sanitized peer-local outcome, independent of global reconcile state.

current.description: Matches the current node-scoped revision/digest and node is active.

stale.description: Not current, never reported, or receive age >= stale_after_seconds.

CreateEnrollmentTokenResponse.description: The token is revealed only once, in this creation response.

EnrollAgentRequest.description:
Persist the proposed random credential before sending this request. Retry
with the same enrollment token, credential, name and enrollment version.

FlowQuery.description:
Internet country is a preview hint, not automatic geolocation. Mesh country
and source country always come from the active-node inventory.

epoch.description: Zero means this node has never acquired a runtime lease.

HeartbeatRequest.description: Node identity is derived exclusively from the node bearer credential.

path.description: Exact ordered full path, including source and destination. No repeats.

policy.description: Saved source intent, retained even when references become invalid.

MeshNode.description: Public active-node inventory; country is administrator-managed metadata.

MeshPathAuthorization.description:
Internal compiled path authorization. Its JSON remains `{ "grants": [...] }`
so schema-version-1 NodeDataplane remains byte-contract compatible.

NetworkSnapshot.description: Saved intent at the global configuration revision. Address pools are immutable.

NodeDataplane.description: One coherent global revision, projected for the authenticated node.

NodeSummary.description: Durable control-plane identity. Last contact is not tunnel health.

epoch.description: Reuses the authenticated managed runtime's acquired epoch, not a new identity.

sequence.description: Independent monotonic discovery report sequence within that epoch.

SourceSelector.description: Empty dimensions are wildcards; dimensions combine with AND, members with OR.

observed_at.description: Repeated reports preserve these times; retransmission is not renewal.

observer.description: Explicit numeric STUN observer endpoint, not a Meshway peer identity.

generation.description: Public process-local runtime generation and socket ordinal.

resource_id.description: Controller listener/candidate ID, never a private runtime token.
